sql.membership: SELECT gm.member_id FROM n_group_members gm JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=gm.group_id AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0 WHERE gm.group_id=:group_id AND gm.user_id=:viewer_id AND gm.status='active'
sql.lock_group: SELECT group_id FROM n_groups WHERE group_id=:group_id AND is_active=1 AND is_deleted=0 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
sql.lock_membership: SELECT gm.member_id FROM n_group_members gm JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=gm.group_id AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0 WHERE gm.group_id=:group_id AND gm.user_id=:viewer_id AND gm.status='active' FOR UPDATE OF gm.status NOWAIT
sql.personal_post: SELECT p.post_id AS source_id,p.post_id AS post_id,p.content AS content FROM n_posts p JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1 WHERE p.is_deleted=0 AND p.post_id BETWEEN 1 AND :max_id AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id,p.post_id)=1 AND (p.author_id=:viewer_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_bookmarks b WHERE b.post_id=p.post_id AND b.user_id=:viewer_id)) AND p.post_id=:source_id
sql.search_personal_post: SELECT p.post_id AS source_id,p.post_id AS post_id,p.content AS content FROM n_posts p JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1 WHERE p.is_deleted=0 AND p.post_id BETWEEN 1 AND :max_id AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id,p.post_id)=1 AND (p.author_id=:viewer_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_bookmarks b WHERE b.post_id=p.post_id AND b.user_id=:viewer_id)) AND DBMS_LOB.INSTR(p.content,:term)>0 ORDER BY p.post_id DESC FETCH FIRST :row_limit ROWS ONLY
sql.group_post:
SELECT p.post_id AS source_id,p.post_id AS post_id,p.content AS content,p.group_id AS group_id
FROM n_group_posts p
JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0
JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1
JOIN n_group_members gm ON gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.user_id=:viewer_id AND gm.status='active'
WHERE p.group_id=:group_id AND p.post_id=:source_id AND p.post_id BETWEEN 1 AND :max_id AND p.is_deleted=0
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
  WHERE (b.user_id=:viewer_id AND b.target_user_id=p.author_id)
     OR (b.target_user_id=:viewer_id AND b.user_id=p.author_id)
)
sql.group_comment:
SELECT c.comment_id AS source_id,p.post_id AS post_id,c.content AS content,p.group_id AS group_id
FROM n_group_comments c
JOIN n_group_posts p ON p.post_id=c.post_id AND p.is_deleted=0
JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0
JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1
JOIN n_users ca ON ca.user_id=c.author_id AND ca.is_active=1
JOIN n_group_members gm ON gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.user_id=:viewer_id AND gm.status='active'
WHERE p.group_id=:group_id AND c.comment_id=:source_id AND p.post_id BETWEEN 1 AND :max_id AND c.is_deleted=0
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
  WHERE (b.user_id=:viewer_id AND b.target_user_id IN (p.author_id,c.author_id))
     OR (b.target_user_id=:viewer_id AND b.user_id IN (p.author_id,c.author_id))
)
sql.search_group_post:
SELECT p.post_id AS source_id,p.post_id AS post_id,p.content AS content,p.group_id AS group_id
FROM n_group_posts p
JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0
JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1
JOIN n_group_members gm ON gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.user_id=:viewer_id AND gm.status='active'
WHERE p.group_id=:group_id AND p.post_id BETWEEN 1 AND :max_id AND p.is_deleted=0
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
  WHERE (b.user_id=:viewer_id AND b.target_user_id=p.author_id)
     OR (b.target_user_id=:viewer_id AND b.user_id=p.author_id)
)
AND INSTR(p.content,:term)>0
ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC,p.is_announcement DESC,p.post_id DESC FETCH FIRST :row_limit ROWS ONLY
sql.search_group_comment:
SELECT c.comment_id AS source_id,p.post_id AS post_id,c.content AS content,p.group_id AS group_id
FROM n_group_comments c
JOIN n_group_posts p ON p.post_id=c.post_id AND p.is_deleted=0
JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0
JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1
JOIN n_users ca ON ca.user_id=c.author_id AND ca.is_active=1
JOIN n_group_members gm ON gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.user_id=:viewer_id AND gm.status='active'
WHERE p.group_id=:group_id AND c.comment_id BETWEEN 1 AND :max_id AND p.post_id BETWEEN 1 AND :max_id AND c.is_deleted=0
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
  WHERE (b.user_id=:viewer_id AND b.target_user_id IN (p.author_id,c.author_id))
     OR (b.target_user_id=:viewer_id AND b.user_id IN (p.author_id,c.author_id))
)
AND INSTR(c.content,:term)>0
ORDER BY c.comment_id DESC FETCH FIRST :row_limit ROWS ONLY
